chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, Allah the Exalted did not grant Satan authority over those who believe and do righteous deeds.
Except for what they voluntarily surrendered of themselves.

key_terms.اسْتَحَلَّهُمْ: They made permissible for themselves / voluntarily surrendered

ai.seo_question: What is the basis of Satan's power over believers according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifying that Satan's authority is not inherent but conditional, relying on the believer's voluntary acceptance of his whispers. This distinction underscores the Shia theological principle of human free will (*ikhtiyar*) remains intact, as Satan can only exert influence over those who choose to follow his guidance rather than being compelled by divine decree.
